note: Own set for the Kakashi Hatake boss. Audio: generated offline by the coordinator with the Kokoro tool (profile kakashi in tools/audio/offline_voice_profiles.json, main repo). Record offline, one file per id at the path in 'file' (mono, 44.1 kHz, Ogg Vorbis), then run tools/audio/kakashi_voice.py. A line without a file shows its subtitle only.

groups.phase_susanoo: phase 4 begins (25 percent): the Perfect Susanoo
groups.victory: every fighter is down, he wins
groups.idle: idle taunt while the fight pauses

lines.text: Maa, maa. I came to read in peace, but it seems you are not going to allow that.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Sorry I am late. I got lost on the road of life.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: manga ch. 2 / anime ep. 1 (his first-meeting excuse), paraphrased; from memory, wiki not reachable

lines.text: You walk in like you own the road. Fine. Let me see what you carry.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: My eye is open. Do not make me use all of it.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Good. That was a real strike. Now let us make this a crowd.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Pakkun, everyone. Get out here, we have company.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: I borrowed this eye from a friend. He would want me to use it well.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Space bends where I look. Try to stand on the right side of it.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.trigger: phase 4 begins (25 percent): the Perfect Susanoo
lines.text: So this is what the last of it feels like. Then I will not hold back.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.trigger: phase 4 begins (25 percent): the Perfect Susanoo
lines.text: Come out. Show them what a promise looks like when it has a sword.
lines.delivery: a sharp shout, clipped, held for a beat
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Raikiri.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: jutsu call-out, name from the series (Raikiri, 'Lightning Cutter'); wiki not reachable

lines.text: Hold still. This will only take one breath.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Oh. You moved. That is annoying.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Not bad. Do it again and I will be impressed.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Little things first. They add up.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Watch the tags, not the knives.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: I saw that. Thank you, I will keep it.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Mine now. Here, have it back.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Lightning Beast. Run it down.
lines.delivery: a sharp shout, clipped, held for a beat
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: It follows. Find a wall.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Water Dragon.
lines.delivery: a sharp shout, clipped, held for a beat
lines.source: jutsu call-out, Water Style: Water Dragon Bullet; wiki not reachable

lines.text: You are wet now. That matters, you will see why.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Hunting Fang. Bring them to the ground.
lines.delivery: a sharp shout, clipped, held for a beat
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: The pack never loses a scent.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: One of me is bad enough. Three is rude, I know.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Surround them.
lines.delivery: a sharp shout, clipped, held for a beat
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Fog. A very old trick, and still a good one.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Breathe slowly. You cannot see me, but I can see you.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Earth Style. Nothing flies through this.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Behind you.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: The door is on the other side. Mind the draft.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Kamui. Raikiri.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: jutsu call-out, names from the series (Kamui Raikiri); wiki not reachable

lines.text: You will not feel where it comes from.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Kamui Shuriken.
lines.delivery: a sharp shout, clipped, held for a beat
lines.source: jutsu call-out, name from the series; wiki not reachable

lines.text: Four doors. Stand in none of them.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Everything goes in. Hold on to something.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Space turns. Let it take you, or fight it.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Too slow.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Nothing there. You hit the air between worlds.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: A log. Sorry, it was the closest thing to me.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Ha. You hit the firewood.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Susanoo.
lines.delivery: a sharp shout, clipped, held for a beat
lines.source: jutsu call-out, name from the series (Susanoo); wiki not reachable

lines.text: Stand behind me. All of you who have not run yet.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: It cracked. Good. I was getting tired of hiding behind it.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Fair enough. That was a strong hit.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Purple Lightning. This is the last of what I have.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Do not let it find your feet.
lines.delivery: a sharp shout, clipped, held for a beat
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Heh. That one stung.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Good. Better than I expected.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Careful. I am still standing.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Those who abandon their comrades are worse than scum. Remember that.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: manga ch. 15 / anime ep. 24 (the 'scum' speech), shortened; from memory, wiki not reachable

lines.text: My chakra is nearly gone. So is the time you have to finish this.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: One more exchange. Make it count.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: That is how it ends when you are careless. I am sorry.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Do not follow them. Back up, breathe, begin again.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.trigger: every fighter is down, he wins
lines.text: It is over. Next time, bring more than strength.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.trigger: every fighter is down, he wins
lines.text: Remember this. Strength alone never protected anyone.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.trigger: idle taunt while the fight pauses
lines.text: Take your time. I was late once, I know the feeling.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.trigger: idle taunt while the fight pauses
lines.text: Maa, are you done catching your breath?
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: his 'maa, maa' verbal habit; line in his manner

lines.trigger: idle taunt while the fight pauses
lines.text: Your friends are watching your back. Do not waste that.
lines.delivery: low, focused, quiet intensity
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: Well. I read the whole book and you wrote the last page. Good ending.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)

lines.text: You are strong. Look after each other, that is where it comes from.
lines.delivery: calm, lazy, a little amused, relaxed breathing
lines.source: in his manner (original wording, no wiki source)
